Not the friendliest bunch, and it kinda makes you feel unwelcome even though the food’s really good.

author: Jessica Teoh
review_text:
Their coffees’ prices are on the higher end, but justified by the “kao-ness” of the coffees.

Their toasts are paired well with coffee.

Overall, a decent place to get light breakfast or afternoon tea.

If you plan to come, it’s better to come by bike. Parking is very very VERY limited.

author: Catherine Tan
review_text: What a hidden gem! I came to Ah Wang Cafe out of curiosity and left completely impressed. Tried their salted coffee—wasn't sure what to expect, but it turned out surprisingly delicious with a perfect balance of saltiness and smooth coffee aroma. The half-boiled eggs were done just right—runny, silky, and paired perfectly with a dash of soy sauce and pepper. The toasted Kahwin bread was crisp on the outside, buttery inside, with that nostalgic kaya-butter combo that hits all the right notes. And the peanut butter toast with milk? Absolutely on point—creamy, comforting, and indulgent in the best way. Definitely a spot worth returning to for a hearty local breakfast!

author: alex cheong
review_text:
Ah Wang Cafe is a nostalgic kopitiam-style coffee shop that claims to have been in business for over 40 years. Stepping into the cafe brings back memories of simpler times, with its retro ambiance and old-school setup. The place offers the classic kopitiam fare — kaya butter toasts, soft-boiled eggs, and traditional nasi lemak. It’s the kind of place that takes you back to childhood breakfasts with family or slow mornings with a newspaper and coffee.

As expected, the menu is simple and straightforward. The toast is crisp with generous kaya and butter, and the soft-boiled eggs are served in the traditional style — perfect for dipping or stirring with a dash of soy sauce and white pepper. The nasi lemak comes with the essentials: sambal, peanuts, anchovies, egg, and a choice of protein, making it a decent and filling option.

However, for someone who enjoys bold and robust coffee, the brew at Ah Wang Cafe might come off as underwhelming. Kopitiam coffee usually has a reputation for being thick, aromatic, and strong, but here it leans towards the milder side. While that may appeal to some, it may not satisfy those looking for a deep caffeine kick.

That said, Ah Wang Cafe still earns its stripes as a legit, no-frills coffee shop. It’s a chill spot to enjoy a slow morning or an afternoon break, especially if you appreciate traditional Malaysian breakfast staples and a relaxed, old-school vibe. Nothing fancy — just simple comfort.

author: Yee Hoon Tee
review_text: Old-school breakfast that brings back memories — kopi, soft buns, and half-boiled eggs. Feels just like the mornings I grew up with. A place must go in Penang!!! ☺️

author: Wong Kuen siang
review_text: I prefer the normal kopi. The salted coffee is unique like caramel but it is just something new and I prefer the old coffee. Simple, clean and airy location below the apartments. Kaya toast is very crispy and best eaten when hot. It will turn soggy once cool down. Kaya is fragrant. Indeed a nice place for coffee and away from the tourist. Will come more regularly . Parking is an issue. Do park a bit further at main road and walk into the housing estate

author: Brewforone
review_text:
📍 阿旺咖啡店 ᴀʜ ᴡᴀɴɢ ᴄᴀꜰᴇ

- This old-school kopitiam has been dishing out comforting Hainanese-style breakfast for over 40 years. It’s the kind of place you’d miss if not for a local tip-off but once you find it, you’ll understand why it has such a loyal following. Located in the middle of apartments and probably only visited by locals.

I kicked off with their signature kaya butter toast and half-boiled eggs. Simple? Yes. But also perfect. The toast had just the right crunch, and their homemade kaya is thick, rich, and not overly sweet, truly homemade and clearly made with care. Pair that with eggs that are consistently soft-boiled (no runny mess or rubbery whites here), and you’ve got a breakfast that hits all the nostalgic notes.

Their black and white coffee are both solid picks, but what surprised me most was the Kiam Kopi (salted coffee). I was skeptical since you don't see it often around Malaysia, but it turned out to be a malty, slightly savory blend that weirdly reminded me of a mocha. Unexpected and surprisingly addictive.

author: Teh Siew Hoon
review_text: Purposely come here to try their salted coffee. A bit disappointed, doesn’t taste like coffee instead it actually tastes more like Milo. But it still good to drink.

author: Lyn Cass
review_text: It’s not your pretty multicoloured latte drinks or matcha-whatever hipster. This is pure wholesome coffee, in a kopitiam that probably your great grandpa would approve of. No frills but the Hainanese coffee slaps like you wouldn’t believe. I don’t write many reviews but this one, deserves a shout out. I will be back.

author: E. T.
review_text:
What a gem!!
Was brought here by a friend or I will have problem locating the place. It was hidden within the low cost council flats by the coast / main road.
Place is very very clean. Brightly lit courtyard & not a single fly!

Great breakfast meals - good for brunch too.
Highly recommended to try the salty coffee (Kiam Kopi). And the nasi lemak bungkus... 👍🏻👍🏻
The half boiled eggs & toast with peanut butter, kaya & butter was good too.

They use QR coded menu where you can order from your table (except for the nasi lemak, you have to take it from the stall & pay separately).
After order was placed, they will send the food to your table. Payment to be made at the stall before you leave.

The seller was very friendly & polite too but sorry for the 4 stars, due to the parking condition. 🙏🏻

author: Hong Aun
review_text: Classic local delicacies on the hidden gem. Their signature coffee is a must try ! Top up with half boiled egg, Nasi Lemak and Bangalli roti. Perfect combo !!

author: Chin Yan
review_text: Away from the city breakfast spot. No queue, good coffee, Bengali roti is good. Parking is limited at the housing area. Do try out their white and black coffee. Salted coffee is just okay for me.

author: Jason
review_text: A pleasant place to have an ol' school breakfast. Their teas and kopi's are all super gao! Buns and egg toasts were good. Nasi Lemak is the typical Chinese style; sweet, non-spicy sambal. Their kaya is on the sweeter side and on sale too (I ended up getting one at RM6). Parking is limited since this cafe is right in the vicinity of low-cost flats.

author: Pauline Tan
review_text: Comfort food, nostalgia location in residential flat community area. Parking a bit challenging but still don’t stop me from coming here for a toast and authentic Malaysian kopi.  Home made Kaya is divine

author: Leonard Wan
review_text:
This cafe (kopitiam) is located in a residential flat area that is slightly remote from the main traffic.

I came here for an afternoon tea, had a hot milk coffee and toast with butter and egg. The coffee is normal, not too sweet. I love the toast however. What I appreciate is the pricing, they are so much affordable.

The environment is pretty decent too. Not too hot, not crowded, you can enjoy your afternoon tea quietly and peacefully there.

author: Lay Ying Yeoh
review_text:
Come here for tea time. Their coffee super gao, we try 小黑 and 小白 this time and want to try other type of coffee for next visit. The toast with butter and Kaya very delicious. Price is reasonable. Quality is definitely excellent 👍

Hard to find parking here, can park at the road side or in the car park of temple

author: Kenn Mullen
review_text: Comfort breakfast food, the classics at its best and a wonderful in-the-neighbourhood vibe. The kayaking and butter on toast can be a challenge for some, but these people have perfected it! The half boiled eggs were super consistent and not over or undercooked. Nothing short of perfection. The one that took me by surprise was their KIAM KOPI (salted coffee) cant say that it was any more salty than salted caramel, and its malty texture made it taste alot like mocha and i LOVE mocha! The nasi lemak was nothing to write home about, but still scratches the itch if you craving for some. Overall score: AWESOME! Cant wait to come back here

author: Red Wind Lee
review_text: Is a "rumah pangsa" kind of coffee store. Is like traditional Singapore store below the flat. Taste was OK and quite special for the salted coffee. Bread was quite mangali...quite a traditional national breakfast in Malaysia. Parking was quite limited as it was original for household.

author: Ann Chee
review_text: The Q was long and eye catching when u pass by the shop one wouldn’t miss noticing why this shop has such long q. So we decided to give it a try, in the q, there were return customers they told us the food is sooo good. Once the shop opened, they can only accommodate 17 ppl, after that one will have to wait for the first batch to finished their meal before there is any empty seats. The shop is not a fancy one, the design layout of the place is not impressive at all. So ppl are here for the food not the environment. On the menu, there are lean, semi lean and fatty pork (pork belly) parts to be deep fried. I choose the semi lean. The portion of the pork is huge thick cut, of course the price also match the portion served which is rm45+. Maybe I have high expectation on the food, I personally think that the ingredients are fresh, well prepared but lack of unique or rather impressive flavour. At first bite, it will immediately give you this “it’s just a regular pork being deep fried” that’s it. If u like deep fried food and pork, this is the place for you.

author: Balee Tong
review_text:
Best Tonkatsu I've had in Penang and Klang Valley. If you can get a table

I waited an hour on a working day afternoon to get a seat in this restaurant. The place is walk in only, no bookings allowed. I probably won't come back due to the uncertainty and time constraints. A place as popular as this can certainly implement a reservation only policy, not the complete opposite which wastes every customers time waiting.

The cabbage, rice and soup are refillable, we are off to a good start. Despite being free flow, the soup is rich and packed with vegetables. The pickles were fresh and crispy.

We ordered both the sakura pork. sirloin and ribeye, the portions are between (180-200g). Long story short, the pork, hands down was perfectly executed. The fat cap was fragrant and an absolute joy to have. However, I couldn't tell the difference between the ribeye and sirloin. Visually yes, taste and texture felt similar. The rice is perfectly cooked as well. The grains was noticeably separate and chewy.

author: Kee Kelven
review_text:
This is the Japanese restaurant that went viral online for its huge tonkatsu, and it truly lived up to the hype. The tonkatsu portions were extremely big and very well cooked. I also really liked their miso soup and Japanese rice, which were surprisingly good. It was my first time having miso soup filled with so much chicken meat and vegetables, instead of the usual small amount of seaweed and tiny tofu found at most restaurants.

Their opening time was 6pm. We arrived at 5.30pm on a Saturday, but there was already a long queue waiting outside. The restaurant only has around 16–17 seats, and unfortunately, my friend and I were the 18th in line, so we had to wait for the second round. Luckily, the staff took down everyone’s name on a waiting list, so we didn’t have to stand there the whole time.

We finally got our seats after about 1 hour. The staff patiently explained the differences between the various pork cuts, and we could watch the chef cooking right in front of us. We ordered the fatty Sakura pork set and the lean premium pork set, and later added an à la carte small muscle katsu. The set came with refillable rice, cabbage, and miso soup.

Out of the three types of katsu we tried, the muscle katsu was my favourite. It had a springier texture and stronger flavour compared to the others. The Sakura pork had a layer of fat that gave a unique texture and taste, but the meat itself was slightly tougher. The premium pork was somewhere in between, and honestly, I couldn’t really tell what made it “premium,” even though it was the thickest cut. That said, it was still cooked nicely with a slight pinkness in the middle.

The best part of all was the light and crispy crust, which was not oily at all. Even after eating so much fried food, we didn’t feel heavy or jelak at all.

author: RJ Ang El
review_text: First time trying and it's amazing! The crust is light and crispy, and the pork is flavourful and juicy. Portion is MASSIVE!! Rice is well cooked and curry sauce is nice. Generous owners provide unlimited servings of rice, curry and salad. Soup has many chunks of tender pork, carrots and some veg with deep flavour in every sip. Everything is cooked and served with ultimate sincerity. We arrived at 11.25am on a thursday and there was already a queue. Lovely and cozy environment, felt like immersing in a japanese tempura bar. Service is top notch and everyone is so friendly and patient. I must go back and try their seafood and black curry!

author: Loretta K.
review_text: Awesome delicious tonkatsu. I have never been disappointed with the quality of the food here. Tender n juicy meat. However, no rsvp, so getting a seat could be a hit n miss. Place feels like a typical homestyle, cozy setting.

author: Kia Sen Tan
review_text: Best Tonkatsu in town ;  Be prepared to wait even on weekdays if going there during meal time.   Their business are always very good since opening until now for few years already.   They have so many regular, including local and foreigner alike.  The food is five stars and service is very attentive ;  the only drawback of the shop is probably their stuffy environment due to the reason that that protein are prepared inside the bar counter before its being serve.

author: Cher Ong
review_text: Firstly, the service here is not very welcoming. They don't have much seats available, it's all surrounding their counters. They make customers wait even when there's empty seats. Menu is also very confusing. Basically there's only 3 types of proteins available & everything is deep-fried. But the menu is super complicated. Everything is sort of like self-service here. They placed your food on top of the counter & u have to take it yourself. Food not very impressive. The pork smell is very strong. Curry tastes is also not to my likings. Price is on the higher side.

author: Frank Wan
review_text:
Friends recommended this Japanese restaurant to us.  We came one day but it was full and had to wait for at least 30 mins.  So we went to other restaurant.  We came early this time to ensure that we would get a seat.  If you want to try this restaurant, please look at their opening hours and came well before the opening time and queue.  If not, you should prepare to wait for at least 30 mins.

We are not disappointed!!! The Tonkatsu (deep-fried pork is so juicy, soft and tasty.  Although they are using local pork, the cooking makes it to the same standard of the one that we had in Japan.  They also serve deep-fried seafood.  All are freshly made at the counter.  You can have set meals (comes with a small starter, and refillable soup and rice) which are value-for-money, or order individual dish.  The portion is big and it should satisfy most people.

The staff are very friendly and efficient.  The restaurant is clean and air-conditioned.

We will came back to try other dishes (especially the black Curry).

author: Q W
review_text:
Our very first try 😋
There are already a lot of people queueing up before the store opens. Refillable rice and soup , huge portions , we ordered two different kinds of tonkatsu, was amazed by the taste, very nyumm 😋 But It takes some time to be served because it is freshly made

author: alex cheong
review_text:
Tonkatsu Akinai in Tanjung Tokong is a Japanese restaurant that has built quite a reputation, and it shows from the moment you arrive. On my first visit, I had to wait close to an hour for a table as the place was completely packed. This alone made me curious to see what the hype was all about. Once seated, I noticed that the menu was not very detailed. Many of the items were written in Japanese, which can be confusing for customers who are not familiar with the cuisine. Because of this, the waitstaff had to go through lengthy explanations at almost every table, which felt inefficient.

The dining environment also left some room for improvement. Despite having several air conditioners, the restaurant was not cool, and the heat from the open cooking near the dining area made it feel rather stuffy. When my order arrived, I had the katsu pork set, which came with rice, salad, and soup. The soup unfortunately was lukewarm on the first try and properly hot only when I requested a replacement. The rice also felt slightly undercooked, which was a letdown.

That said, the highlight was definitely the fried pork. The breading was crispy, the meat juicy, and it paired perfectly with the tangy tonkatsu sauce. The salad was fresh and added a nice balance to the meal. Overall, Tonkatsu Akinai shows potential but suffers from inconsistency. While not a bad experience, I feel some improvements are needed to match its popularity.

author: Billy Lim
review_text: Worth a visit, and there’s something gratifying about that crunch of the tonkatsu, paired with the side dishes and the simple Japanese-eatery ambiance. For a lunchtime meal (or early dinner) in Penang, especially if you’re around Tanjung Tokong, this is a solid pick.

author: JH
review_text:
The food was delicious and reasonably priced!
I went on a Saturday without a reservation and was told the wait would be 10–15 minutes, but I ended up waiting nearly 40 minutes.🫠🫠
Because I had another appointment, I had to eat in a rush and took the rest to go.

That said, the staff were all very friendly and the food was absolutely worth it.
Prices are fair, and I’d definitely recommend this place.

On weekends, the wait can be quite long, so I recommend making a reservation in advance.

Next time, I’ll try to visit during a less busy time!👍

author: Georgina Liew
review_text:
Best tonkatsu I had so far. Pork tonkatsu is delicious with big serving and the soup is amazing.
However they only have 17 seats so queue up is unavoidable. And no bookings allowed.

author: Jimmy Wah
review_text: The best in Penang. Crispy, fresh pork fillet which is excellent. Soup is flavorful. Rice is on point. Staff is friendly too. Sometimes queue can be intimidating but it’s worth the wait. Been here many times and food is consistently good.

author: K
review_text:
The pork katsu is thick and juicy. Even if it's fried, it's doesn't taste oily at all.

What i find interesting is that you can choose the types of pork and cuts.

However, there are limited seats so queueing are common.

author: Eric Foo
review_text:
Amazing, tender and delicious Hire Katsu. Tasty refillable soup. It’s a small place so be prepared for a queue.
Tip: go early, leave your name, number and order. Then go shopping next door. Still my go-to Tonkatsu place.

Had another really good dinner here. The Menchi Tonkatsure is not simply ground pork but coarsely ground to have texture and a cheese stuffed inside.

The queue seems to be getting longer, with weekend latecomers turned away. I would suggest getting there before 6 on weekends to get your spot

author: Mia
review_text: For someone who usually avoids pork, finishing a whole plate of tonkatsu curry rice says a lot about how delicious it is. The soup is also tasty and comes with free refills.

author: Huiyi
review_text:
This is the 7th time I came to this small yet busy establishment
Be prepared for a long queue, do not worry though as the staff kindly takes your name and number and gives you a call when a table is available, in the meantime you can have a walk at the mall next door.
The wait is 100% worth it. The best tonkatsu you can find in Penang (and better than most tonkatsu specialty shops in KL) with refillable rice and soup. The panko breadcrumbs gave the crust the perfect crisp, the pork fillet so soft and juicy, the soup so filling with lots of ingredients in it, and the rice is so fluffy and fragrant.
The staff are all very nice and helpful, kudos to them!

author: Titus Maximus
review_text:
Only downside is the LONG QUEUE during peak hour. Waiter for almost 2 hours, due to only about 10 counter seats.

However, the food worth the wait. Chose the soft pork, very juicy.
Miso flavour was ok, will try the curry next time.

Price is slightly expensive but there are 3 pieces of thick pork so it's worth it.

author: Ian Pomato
review_text: The best place to fix your tonkatsu craves. The pork is fatty and juicy with perfect crust. The tonkatsu doesn't need any fancy dressing or seasoning as it is already flavourful enough. This place is crowded all the time so best is to come on weekday lunch hour.

author: Yi-Ping Ku
review_text:
🍣 A Truly Delightful Japanese Dining Experience – Perfect for Families

We had the absolute pleasure of dining at this charming Japanese restaurant, and I must say, it exceeded all expectations. Every dish was a masterpiece — beautifully presented, exquisitely balanced, and bursting with authentic flavour. From the first bite to the last, it was clear that great care and craftsmanship had gone into every element of the meal.

What truly set this place apart, however, was the warm and thoughtful hospitality. The owner personally visited each table, offering detailed explanations of the dishes and checking in to ensure everything suited our taste. It was a lovely touch that made us feel genuinely welcomed and cared for.

The restaurant is also wonderfully family-friendly. Our children were not only accommodated but made to feel right at home — a rare and much-appreciated quality in fine dining establishments.

We left with full hearts and satisfied appetites, already planning our next visit. This gem of a restaurant comes highly recommended — a must-try for anyone who appreciates exceptional Japanese cuisine and heartfelt service. We will most certainly be returning.

author: Angel Lee
review_text: An excellent omakase experience. The sashimi was exceptionally fresh, showcasing the chef’s refined knife skills and deep understanding of ingredients. Each course was thoughtfully prepared and beautifully presented. The ambiance was calm, elegant, and comfortable, making the entire dining experience truly enjoyable. Highly recommended for anyone who appreciates authentic Japanese omakase.

author: leewei Saw
review_text:
We celebrated our BFF’s birthday at Kazumasa Sushi Omakase, and it was an unforgettable experience! We had the fresh unagi omakase, and every course was beautifully presented, fresh, and full of flavor — definitely worth it.
Chef Sammy was warm and welcoming. He explained each dish with such passion, making the whole meal feel personal and engaging. The highlight of the night was when he surprised our friend with a special birthday dessert — beautifully decorated ice cream, a perfect crème brûlée, and even a small gift. Such a thoughtful and heartwarming gesture!
Highly recommend Kazumasa for anyone looking for high-quality sushi, great service, and a memorable omakase experience — especially for special occasions.

author: Crystal Tan
review_text:
The services and food quality are excellent, so far the best japanese restaurant in Penang.

The price for all the dishes that we ordered is reasonable.

Definitely will come back again!

author: Jas Khaw
review_text: Very yummy UMA omakase prepared by chef Sammy, every bite has its wow factor.

author: Casper
review_text: Tried the Takumi omakase set and it was definitely worth it. The highlight of the experience was the 6 piece special sushi prelude before the warm main dish. It was amazing. Each sushi presented was absolutely a treat with each tasting getting increasingly better. For the warm dish, topped up additional for the A5 miyazaki wagyu beef with tofu in a milky miso broth. The service was exceptional too, with the staff explaining the ingredients for each presented dish, as well as a few performative presentation from the chef for some special dishes. Overall a great experience with the freshest ingredient for the price point and would return to try other dishes. 😋

author: SITI N
review_text: Love it. My first time trying omakase in Penang. We went for the omakase RM588++ per person... everything was delicious. fresh air-flown oyster from japan, dry aged maguro, uni, various sashimi, cod sperm, rice popcorn, fish roe & caviar, black truffles, female snow crab. my friend had tuna eye ball soup... yummy haha. very friendly and informative staff members - front staff & chefs. Highly recommend!

author: Abeygayle Lee
review_text: Exquisite omakase experience! Each dish was a masterpiece, beautifully presented with fresh ingredients. Flavors were well-balanced, and the chef's creativity shined throughout. A must-try for Japanese food enthusiasts!

author: Frank Wan
review_text:
This is certainly the best Japanese restaurant that I went to in Penang.  We had the set lunch this time as we have not booked the seats for Omakase in advance.  The Omakase counter was full.  The services and food quality are excellent.  The taste of the food is the same as that we experienced in Japan.  The price for the lunch sets are very reasonable.  We will come back to try the Omakase next time.

Updated on 13 January 2025:

We came back after a few months later, and found that the restaurant has already changed management.  The restaurant had no guest when we walked in and had only two tables during our lunch.  They cut down a number of staff and only one assistant chef was retained.  We are shocked that for the same menu, the price has gone up for  more than 50%.  For example, the Sashimi set was RM50 per set but now RM88 😱.  Although the quality of the food maintained similar standard, it was a big shock as the returning customers who knew the previous prices.  There are some other choices for Japanese food with similar price!

author: Oli H
review_text: Had my birthday meal here, and really enjoyed the Omekase. As we sat down some of the fish arrived from the airport straight from Japan.. so we got to see the chef go at it full on!  The staff were extremely attentive and super fun to chat to; honestly they will do anything to help make your experience too notch and have superb knowledge of the cuisine. The Sake Sommelier really knew his stuff too and picked out a lovely few Sake for us to try with the meal. The chef was excellent  and  explained everything in great detail....very Interesting indeed. He even grated the real Wasabi for us to try straight off the grater!! Delightful and so Aromatic! A great experience and such a treat! Come give it a go People! 👍👍👍👍👍👍

author: Dixon Chai
review_text: Had a wonderful dining experience at Kazumasa Japanese Restaurant! The sashimi was exceptionally fresh, and we enjoyed the sushi set which was delicious. We also tried the gratin crab which did not disappoint. Although the prices are on the higher side, the quality and taste justify the cost. We’re already looking forward to trying their omakase on our next visit. Highly recommend for anyone craving authentic Japanese cuisine!

author: Qiru Soh
review_text: I would say definitely the best omakase restaurants in Penang! Food was amazing, especially the uni. Service was excellent as well. Waiters had really nice manners and etiquette.

author: Anil Soekhoe
review_text:
We had an amazing experience at the omakase table. The chef and his whole team are so much focussed on delivering a good time with the best quality sushi and sashimi that we have ever tasted! We even tried food that we never ate before and the chef made us try all these new fish.

This place is a must go when you are in Penang. We visited 2 times in 4 days we spent in Penang.

Next to the fact that they have amazing fresh food, the talks with the chef and his team made us feel so welcome.

Once again, I’m from Europe and dine on a regular basis in high quality restaurants, but this place is a hidden gem when it comes to quality, hospitality and honesty. Worth every cent spent.

Thanks Ron and your team and hope to see you again.

Chocolate regards from Lucia and Anil (the pastry and chocolate guy)

author: Lee
review_text:
Came here with friends during lunch for Omakase without reservation. The staff was graciously welcoming us in. Luckily it wasn't fully occupied, hence we were given the bar seat. Since it was my first Omakase experience, hence I have no comparison to draw with unlike my other 2 friends. They were certainly impressed and wowed away by the food prepared by the chef. As for me, as I was recovering from COVID and in midst of regaining my sense of smell and taste, I guess I do enjoy some of the stronger tasting dishes, and especially the texture of the food. I liked the attention paid to the details on the combination of the food, the sequences of having them in order to fully savour the textures and flavours of each ingredients the chef has prepared. Even their cutleries are fascinating and cute. Again, I would say I'm giving 4 🌟 even though I couldn't taste all food but because of the atmosphere, customer service, food presentation and the chef's skills while preparing our Omakase.
I underestimated their food portion, thinking I would still be hungry after the course meal, which was NOT true. We were full and satiated(so much for our back-up plan to head to Edo-Ichi/Daorae across the street thereafter). Well worth the meal indeed.
Will definitely return again to fully enjoy the taste the next time I get my taste and smell back.
Side note:
Better to make reservations for bar counter to watch all the action.
Their selection of sake is delightful, also they allow you to choose a sake cup design you like.

author: Jia Chyi
review_text:
Enjoyed the food and the ambience very much! All the ingredients are served freshly 🥰
Chef and waiters are friendly and helpful 😚
Suitable for couple dating or japanese food lovers 🥰
Highly recommended!

author: Suhaila Kasim
review_text: This restaurant is one of our favorite Japanese restaurants in penang . Our favorite is tongue stew ( is a must have ) . The sushi and sashimi are made from fresh ingredients.

author: Lim Jin Jhu
review_text: Had an amazing omakase experience here! Great fresh food and good service👍

author: Lucia Podmanická
review_text: Great sushi and sashimi. Amazing place to eat at the omakase dining table! What an amazing experience to remember.

author: Josephine Ong
review_text:
Ordered the assorted sashimi which comes out fresh sweetness and moist.
The lunch set that was ordered is perfectly cooked.  The tempura is thin and crispy while the unagi and white fish are grilled just right

author: Michelle Sterling, PMP
review_text:
I had the chance to try Kazumasa and was not disappointed.
After trying 8 local sushi places since arriving in Penang. Most were highly recommended but only one was passable.
As an avid lover of good food I had a lovely experience with the Kazumasa Set Lunch a good value at $55RM and an attentive service team.
The lunch set gave me a quick understanding of their approach to food preparation and service.
After struggling to recover from the effects of Covid 19, they in my opinion got it right today.
Service was attentive and informative and the food was prepared with care. As I watched the chef grate the fresh wasabi at the Omakase station my excitement grew.
Food preparation in the kitchen and at the sushi station were closely synchronized and hot items were still piping hot when they arrived at the table and sushi and sashimi was what I hoped for, fresh, clean and tasty.
If you have time and feel nostalgic for a taste of Japan, Kazumasa provides that. Whatever challenges they faced are meticulously overcome through care, attention and craftsmanship.
Planning my next visit and will try the Chef's Choice Omakase.

author: Ivy
review_text: First time visit for dinner and the cafe is located just right behind the McDonald. We ordered scallop Alfredo pasta and Hawaiian chicken burger. The burger tastes delicious but I think the pasta is a bit creamy and heavy due to its carbonara sauce. We also ordered a Belgium chocolate cake which is also quite nice and not too sweet. We also get two free dessert for leaving a google review! Overall, chilled and nice dining experience!

author: Alson Ong
review_text:
First time visit here, non-local

Came here for early dinner around sunset time. This place gives a good vibe and ambience with the Balinese style renovation. I ordered the new menu: Crispy Softshell Crab Burger, which is good but somehow feels that it would be better if another sauce such as creamy buttermilk or salted egg sauce is used instead of tartar sauce for the burger. The fries are fried to perfection - Crispy and Filling! The staff served well as well. And, staying at The Palm Suite entitled me a 10% discount off from the bill ☺️

author: Nur Hidayah Ruslan
review_text: 24 Sept. Cloudy and windy. Calm spot. Friendly crew. Nice outdoor setup. We had beef bolognese spaghetti and fries. Quite nice and good portion. Complimentary home made ice cream given. Appreciated. Nice vibe and atmosphere. Less traffic and recommended for mind healing ❤️🌿🌸🥰😘

author: Amery H.
review_text:
Great food! Great atmosphere! Ample parking space, and it's pet-friendly! Will definitely come back here again. It's also very windy so you don't have to worry about it being hot or sweating. The restaurant is located behind the suites (the suites doesn't allow pets though), so just walk around the side and you'll find Palm cafe & Bistro.

It isn't crowded either, at least not when we visited, so that's great!

author: Phuong Do
review_text:
The food is western style with breads, burgers and spagetti. It served hot when you start orders. Seafood is fresh, the taste is also good tho and proportion is not small.
Drinks here also good. Coconut is so sweet, coffee is average.
I came here for lunch, its a bit hot so sit inside. The decoration outside with trees, wooden tables and chairs are cute. It must be very chill when sitting outside at night. Maybe then time them :)
The price is lil high compared to standard.

author: Venus GWC
review_text:
Delicious and big portion oriental chicken chop.
Well liked by elderly.

Gambas is yummy!
Muscle pot is not bad too.

Nice ambient and atmosphere.

Sitting outside will be a good idea if the weather is not too hot.

author: Wayne C. Robinson
review_text: By far, the best restaurant in Penang. Great everything. Will return soon. 2nd time was a disappointment, and we brought friends. We made a reservation with Vincent. We got there and the guy said there was no Vincent and that this was not The Palm Restaurant. He sent us to the back to another place. Very confusing. Hamburger was shit. Cheap bun. Very sweet sauce and way too much. Price unjustified. Unsure if we will return.

author: Eliz Tiew
review_text:
This restaurant is an absolute gem! The environment is wonderfully cozy and incredibly relaxing, creating an atmosphere where you can truly unwind and enjoy your meal. It's the perfect setting for a leisurely and comfortable dining experience.
And the food? Oh, the food is simply mouth-wateringly delicious! Every dish we tried was bursting with flavor and perfectly prepared, leaving us craving more. Highly recommended!

author: Ritz Street
review_text: The 2 of us ordered the truffle mushroom soup, spicy Mexican pasta and the prawn pasta. The food was excellent; all cooked just right, seasoned well and you can taste that the ingredients used was fresh. The service was very helpful and polite. We will definitely come again.

author: Nero
review_text:
The deco and design of this place is absolutely stunning. The location may be a bit of distance from the beach, yet, defying all odds, it truly lives up to its name "The Palm".

With the beachy vibes, lovely benches, and sandy colors, you can tell the thought and hardwork that has gone to this location.

We had different types of meatballs, Swedish style and Italian, both of them taste fantastic. The strawberry milkshake is creamy and juicy, justice done to all strawberry lovers.

author: viona yong
review_text: The café has a really nice and cozy environment, perfect for relaxing or catching up with friends. The food is okay, not outstanding but decent for the price. Overall, it’s a good place to enjoy the atmosphere.

author: Sandra Ang
review_text:
🌴 The Palm Cafe – A Hidden Gem with Bali Vibes! 🌴

Stepping into The Palm Cafe instantly gave me Bali vibes – relaxed, tropical, and cozy. The decor and ambiance are absolutely charming! 🌺

Tried their food and was genuinely impressed – everything we ordered was delicious and well-presented. It’s a great spot to unwind and enjoy a good meal.

The environment is lovely overall, though it did get a little noisy at times due to kids running around. But that aside, it’s still a wonderful place for dinner with friends or family.

Definitely worth a visit – will be back again soon! 👍✨

author: Vaidesvari Naidu
review_text: The atmosphere was relaxed and inviting, perfect for a midday break. The staff were incredibly friendly and made great recommendations. Service was quick without feeling rushed, and the food came out hot and well-presented.Prices were fair for the quality, and portion sizes were just right.

author: Serene
review_text: Really loved this café! The nachos were super tasty, seriously one of the best I’ve had. The vibe is really calm and aesthetic—great place to chill or catch up with friends. Tried the pasta too, and it was cooked just right. Oh, and the coffee? So good! Will definitely be back!

author: MeeShan -Shane
review_text: Really like this cafe for the food and drink they been prepared. Good to experience and wonderful service with good food good mood and good place

author: Nurul Nadzifah Abdul Latiff
review_text: Thought this place would be packed when I came—but nope, it was super chill and cozy, which was a lovely surprise! The vibes are on point, perfect for hanging out or just taking a breather. Food was spot on—exactly like the menu promised. I had the chicken chop with black pepper sauce and WOW, sooo good! Bonus points: the whole place is crazy Instagrammable. Cute corners everywhere. Will definitely be back!

author: Mathurada Saisema (Smilesm_zx)
review_text: I came here on my holiday. Nice place which nearby our hotel. Food also yummy. I like the chicken popcorn 🦋🦋

author: Shirley Lim
review_text: Delicious beef hamburger, but the puree is a little salty. Yummy soft-shell crab spaghetti, more sauce will be better :)

author: Shafeena Asmidar (midotb2uty)
review_text: The food was decent and ambient was very perfect for ootd. The service was top notch. Love the food

author: nadiah abmajit
review_text: The Palm Café & Bistro, Penang is a cozy, tropical-themed cafe in Tanjung Tokong. It’s known for its Bali-inspired decor, chill vibes, and lots of Instagram-worthy spots. The menu mixes local and Western dishes from nasi lemak to pancakes and pasta. People love the friendly staff, relaxing ambiance. A great place to unwind, take nice photos, and enjoy tasty food.

author: Félix
review_text: Nieces and nephew, while in KL I definitely had to try Uncle Roger! On the 7th floor of the Pavilion shopping mall, it’s a very colourful (orange!) diner style restaurant. Even though the atmosphere seems a bit cold, probably due to its location and uninspired service, it’s very popular especially with families and younger kids. But at the end of the day, who cares when we’re here for one thing and one thing only?! And I have to say, Uncle Roger delivers! The fried rice is full of flavour and unmistakable wok hei. Even on a low carb diet I couldn’t help but finish the plate… And come back the day after for seconds! I highly recommend to check it out if you’re in Malaysia, you won’t regret it, and it’s reasonably priced - FUIYOH!

author: Siew Kiat Tai
review_text: My son is Uncle Roger's fan so giving one of fuiyoh! Restaurants a visit is a must. We went to the Pavillion store in the evening. Unfortunately most of the menu items were unavailable. Only egg fried rice was available. Anyway, we ordered one spicy one and one non spicy. The fried rice was done well. The rice was not too oily and ful of flavours. We also ordered uncle rogers favourite and one berry lychee drink. The drinks were ok. So overall, the experience was ok. The atmosphere was great. I wish there was more dinner options.

author: How Foong
review_text:
Fuiyoh! I finally found this restaurant, is the building tower at Level 7 beside Pavillion Mall, not the level 7 in Pavillion Mall.
Fuiyoh! The fried rice is dark in color, and taste OK, not very salty, but the rice very crunchy, like I am taking my breakfast  Koko-Kruch.
Fuiyoh! The Wok Hei White Corn aka Pearl corn is so sweet and tasty but the price really Fuiyoh, only 1 pearl white corn serving cost rm27... (Pearl white corn itself already taste very sweet), Wok Hei really got enhance the corn flavour or not.
Fuiyoh, their Crispy Chicken is OK. Taste good. Price same as Wok Hei white corn.
Fuiyoh! The Passionista drinks I like it, taste sparkling, combination with sweet and sour perfectly, but refill so exp, only discount rm2 if want refill another full cup.
K thanks Bye

author: Muhammad Nur Ikhwan Ismail
review_text:
my friend told me “theres only so much you can do with fried rice” and while i agree with him, i would expect a restaurant that highlights fried rice as it’s main dish would execute a perfect fried rice but alas, the wok hey was weak and the fried rice itself was pretty mild-tasting without the sambal. we also got the mee goreng and surprisingly, the mee goreng got a better taste profile than the fried rice (in my opinion lah). 3/5 stars (generous rating)

the sides: satay was disappointing, what was served to me is not a satay in my definition 😭 looks fried instead of bakar over charcoal and the sambal kacang was tastelesss. (2/5 star)

and omg the cabbage??? raw cabbage with drizzle of sweet sauce and they call it “King of Flavour Cabbage” 😃…. the most disappointing dish lol… 0.5/5 star

final words, i think uncle roger should r&d the side dishes better. i would summarise my experience as “decor kedai lagi best dari makanan dia biasa je nyah”.

best regards :)

author: PurpleGreen
review_text: Gave this place a try and overall it was alright. The fried rice dishes were acceptable and surprisingly had some wok hay which was nice. The petai fried rice could have had a stronger flavour but at least they were generous with the petai. The drinks were way too sweet, we had both hot and iced lemon tea and even after adding water they still tasted sweet. Overall a decent meal but there is room for improvement.

author: Abby Y
review_text: Difficult to find this shop in the mall as a tourist, so we were glad when we spotted the unmistakable orange sign. Well decorated restaurant to Uncle Roger's theme. QR code to look at menu and make order. Spicy fried rice was nice- especially the sambal! Kimchi fried rice- kimchi taste wasn't strong. Mala popcorn chicken wasn't as spicy as expected. The drinks came in a nice cup too. Overall wholesome and pleasant experience, but we didn't think we have a reason to visit a second time.

author: Pradipta Baskara
review_text:
Ordered special fried rice which surprise me because they have bunga kantan on the nasi goreng. Fried rice is so tasty i really like it. The fried chicken is also crispy, juicy, and can taste the rempah also.

Order the spicy fried rice but i dont feel any slight of spicy taste, haiyaa why so weak add more chili lah.

The price itself is actually pretty ok and worth it (if i dont need to remember on how weak the Indonesia currency is).

Oh and i love the package of the tissue.

author: Hassan Ghaffar
review_text:
Fuiyoh!! I have been a fan of @mrnigelng (Uncle Roger) he is hilarious. when I saw that he has his own restaurant in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia @fuiyohitsuncleroger and its #halal had to check it out. went to the location inside Pavillion Mall. I went with the Special Fried Rice with Shrimp and the Mala Popcorn Chicken. The Fries Rice was good, very flavorful with a kick to it, also the popcorn chicken was great aswell, be ready for that spice to kick in. overall we enjoyed the experience.

#foodphotography #foodstagram #foodblogger #foodblog #foodlovers #foodpic #foodpics #foodie #foodies #halal #halalfood #unclerogereggfriedrice #uncleroger #fuiyoh

author: Shaun Lin
review_text:
My partner and I visited on 5th November 2025.

We ordered a special fried rice, and a special fried noodle (chow mien).

The food was delicious. The eggs were perfectly fried. Nice crusty base, soft body, with a perfect runny yolk. Fried rice had the right amount of heat, flavour, and a nice touch of umami, aroma, depth, and texture that's added from the finely diced ginger flower. Most importantly, it had wok hei!

The sambal belacan sauce was a great pairing with the fried rice. It had some sweetness, but it leaned towards the savoury side. I topped every spoon of fried rice with just a touch it and it brought a whole new level of depth to range of flavours that the fried rice already had.

The chow mien was amazing. Noodles were well cooked. It had a wonderful aroma, and rich in flavour. She ordered with a side of fried belachan chicken. Perfectly fried. Crispy on the outside, juicy, and tender on the inside with a nice amount of belacan used to season it.

Is it on the pricier side? Yes, but you get what you pay for; quality.

As for the ambience, it's an American retro diner style fitting, with a little twist of uncle Roger's essence, ranging from ceiling and wall lamps, neon signs, and the choice of style in the seats and tables. Music choices enhanced this effect with the old school songs playing in the background too! Such attention to detail!

Well done to the cook, and the team for the food and service too!

Amazing first time experience. I'm glad I came by, and I will definitely be back with other family members too! What a treat!

author: Chen Darek (Areken)
review_text: Not too bad.. but less choice..only fried rice available. Taste of fried rice is good ... No complain on that. Environment nicely design with Uncle Roger signature orange color. Price wise.. consider one of the budget price available in Pavilion mall .

author: Emmeline Siak
review_text: Fried rice not bad wor. Had the wok hei and tasted good. Even my hk colleagues also say the fried rice was fantastic! If they hve more other dishes will be even better.

author: Firdaus Mapasisi
review_text:
Came in with modest expectations, simply wanting to give the famous Uncle Roger Nasi Goreng a try. I ordered the spicy version, which arrived with sambal and a perfectly cooked sunny-side-up egg with a rich, melted yolk.

The very first bite caught me by surprise,the nasi goreng was full of flavour and carried that unmistakable Malaysian authenticity. It genuinely felt like home.

The sambal deserves special mention too. The heat was just right, beautifully balanced with salty and umami notes; a perfect complement to the dish.

Kudos to the team for delivering such a satisfying plate.
One last word: Fuyooo!

author: Lee Yien
review_text: It's their 1 yr anniversary and there's no Q at the restaurant during lunch. Ordered their egg fried rice and i really like it. The flavour is just right, not too salty and rice is cooked perfectly, not too dry nor mushy. The service staff who serves us were all good. Overall i had a good meal and glad that i came to give it a try.

author: Yusuf Limbada
review_text:
The Hype Definitely over hyped  there is zero atmosphere in the store at all!!

You know it needs a personality…. Feels like a cateen vibe…

Food i enjoyed main because cant compare it to much as i hardly nice eat fried rice… but was nice flavour i enjoyed, food came quick and hot… the attention to detail also good the cups are super cool ♥️❤️♥️

It only lacked vibe and energy!!!

author: Glara Y.
review_text: I honestly don’t understand why this place is getting bashed. We almost skipped it because of the reviews, but tried it in the end at my son’s insistence - and we’re so glad we did! The fried rice came out in about 10 minutes and was so tasty that we finished every grain on the plate. It goes perfectly with their chili sauce. The satay was great too. My suggestion: don’t read too much into the reviews - just give this place a try!

author: Jayden Kusuma
review_text: Food is okay, great fried rice but not out of the ordinary amongst any south east asian fried rice dish. Staff does barely and dine in orders are done via a QR code on the table. Costs quite a bit and DOES NOT TAKE CASH. Came here when the hype died down on a weekend and place was empty. Mid at best, for the price, not recommended.

author: Faith
review_text:
Maybe we are lucky to come at a good time with a good chef because this was really one of the good fried rice I’ve had in a while (and in town)

The rice is super fragrant and the spiciness is damn good with it! The portion is actually good for two to share and try it! The price is also reasonable as it was on a discount during the September period offer

author: Michael Tsang
review_text:
For a comedian that has a massive emphasis on fried rice, this disappointed me.
I didnt come in expecting the worlds most gourmet fried rice, but I expected it to be decent and tasty.

Decor and ambience is very much uncle Roger. And you know you're in a themed restaurant.

Service was slow! And there was only maybe 8 people eating at the time!

My meal came out before my drink.

Cashless payments only.

Upon my first bite, a over powering burnt taste and bland then. Hard bits.
So,
Part of the rice portion must have been literally fried in the oil while heating up the wok. It felt like I was eating tiny bits of plastic, but no, it was just rice that had lost its fluffiness.
Wok hei was way overdone and basically overpowered any other taste that could have come from the rice, and ofcourse MSG!
Chicken satay was decent enough, not much more I can say about that.
The drink i ordered was a berry lychee which was lovely, but I think it was missing the lemon slices as i had none but it says it on the menu.
Also its a souvenir cup with the drink.

Overall, I'm happy I've tried it. But its not a place I would really go back to.
But who knows.

author: Little L (and the family)
review_text: I was surprised by how good and tasty it was (sorry Uncle Roger🤣)I have to admit. All of our food was delicious though my simple egg fried rice came a little cold compared to the rest of the food and it was a bit pricey, but it was still really tasty. Would go again.

author: Fellicia Swanny
review_text:
RM16 for a plate of fried rice topped with a sunny side up but without other sides.  I tried without chilli.  I could taste a nice Wok Hei on my first spoonful of rice (without eggs).

The sunny side egg was still runny and it does make the dish appetizing overall.

It was not greasy and overall the plate was filling enough.  Obviously different from Ding Tai Fung (which emphasizes the taste of the eggs).

Funky and joyful ambience and decor.  I won't come here on purpose to eat but if I am around, this is an option to consider, especially lunch.

Am glad for uncle Roger being able to monetize his brand; fits his image quite perfectly and the food is not bad.

author: Venus
review_text: I had to check out this restaurant since it’s so popular—and it totally lived up to the hype! My best picks were the nasi lemak and the pandan toast—absolutely perfect. The rest of the dishes I tried were just delicious all around. Definitely worth the visit!

author: Bee Leng Leong
review_text: Last week I was at Pavilion, Kuala Lumpur to meet up with an old friend from overseas. After our dinner at one of the eateries there, we walked around the shopping mall for some snacks to munch on. We stopped by this Oriental Kopi which serves a wide variety of popular , local Malaysian cuisine n street food. There were long queues on both sides of the shop. On the left side of the shop was a long queue of customers waiting to pay for their items they wanted to get. On the opposite side of the shop n on the right side was also a long queue of customers waiting to order their food n drinks n paying for their food. On the opposite here , are tables n chairs for the dining in customers. Wow the food n drinks must be so excellent to attract such a large crowd! Look at the nearby eateries- you can see only a few tables were occupied! This place was overcrowded. I also joined in the excitement n joined in the queue cos I wanted to buy a box of their signature white coffee to try back home. I queued up on the left n paid for my box of instant white coffee. With that, I drove home. I have tried the coffee n it’s really a good local coffee. Worth the waiting n joining the queue in getting it. Next day , I would like to try the local cuisine at this place.

author: Henry Yap
review_text:
The outlet is inside Pavilion and is quite big and has a lot of seats but there are just too many people at a time regardless of the time that visit, especially during lunch and dinner hours. Despite the crowds, queueing time was about 20 minutes which considers not too long…

The menu serves local delights mainly, and I ordered different type of food and all tasted good…

Do not expect to have high level of service due to the crowds, but any requests responded quickly.

Overall value for money- Food is not that expansive especially with quite a big portions each, I have been there 3 times in 3 days…

Recommends to all that want to try local delights with a not too bad environment👍

author: Irvan Irawan Jie
review_text: A very good Malaysian food restaurant. All the things we ordered was excellent. The wait for acceptable and we can order first so that the food came right after we sat down. They also sell good egg tart, kaya jam, coffee mix, instant noodles and chilli paste.

author: SuBi BH
review_text:
I think this branch is very popular among foreigners. Expect a 15min queue if dining in on a weekday for lunch.

Located quite far inside L1, need to walk quite  a bit from Pavillion side entrance.

Amazing food as always. I love the dry pan mee and nasi lemak very much! 😋

author: ntp
review_text:
My first time trying sambal here and it was amazing! The bread with a big chunk of butter in the middle was also something I’ve never had before.
absolutely loved it, 10/10. Highly recommend visiting!

author: Chris T
review_text:
We went earlier before dinner crowd. First timw for parents eating here.  Few times for me as usual the food is good. Portion and price is just right.
The curry soup is nice 👍🏻

author: Kristia Sekar
review_text:
Didn’t get to try everything because the queues were craazy, but I instantly fell in love with the egg tart 🤍
So incredibly delicious, the pastry texture is to die for, and the sweetness of the custard is just perfectly balanced.

I’d definitely come back again just for the egg tart!

author: Venus Chiam
review_text: Lots of classic Malaysian dishes, plus some limited-edition snacks. I really love the newly launched Purple Sweet Potato Taro Pineapple Bun 💜. The egg tarts, coffee, and nasi lemak are also must-tries. Crowded with tourists, so expect a queue. Souvenirs available too.

author: Gastronomic Nomad
review_text:
Food quality is rock solid, the old school traditional taste sustained
All the Malaysian classic old school dishes are here
Regardless how great the food is, it is way too much to que for it, wait half an hour for it since you certainly can find equivalent alternative easily nearby
This myth is consistently turn into reality by the eaters who may have been mislead by the social media
As for the pop up restaurant, it is not only crowded but cramping into a tiny space with inadequate space between the customers
Seriously not ideally for hygiene noise and comfort reasons

author: Puti Adissa
review_text: This place is a must visit! All the food is absolutely delicious and definitely worth the wait😍😍 My biggest tip is to come early, even before they open, so you don't have to wait in a long line. The egg tarts are the star🥰 they are incredibly fresh and superrr flakyy🫶🏻The drinks are great too! Don't forget to grab their sachet coffee as a souvenir. The only downside is that the nastar cookies are really hard to find; they seem to be sold out at every location.

author: Verdinand Tampubolon
review_text:
I had a wonderful dining experience at Oriental Kopi, Pavilion Mall. Here’s what I tried:
Egg Tart 🥧
The egg tart was absolutely delightful—crispy, flaky pastry on the outside with a smooth, custardy filling. The egg flavor was rich but not at all “eggy” or unpleasant, making it very enjoyable and well-balanced in sweetness.
White Coffee ☕
The white coffee was aromatic and comforting, with a smooth body and just the right balance of bitterness and sweetness. A perfect pairing with the egg tart.
Hainanese Chicken Rice 🍗🍚
The Hainanese chicken rice was fragrant, with tender chicken served alongside flavorful rice cooked in chicken broth. The dipping sauces complemented it well, making it authentic and satisfying.
Fried Chicken Rice 🍖🍚
The fried chicken rice was another highlight—the chicken was crispy on the outside yet juicy inside. It came with the same fragrant rice, which elevated the dish beyond just a simple fried chicken meal.
Overall, Oriental Kopi serves quality food with a good mix of local favorites and kopitiam classics. Highly recommended if you’re visiting Pavilion Mall and looking for a hearty yet comforting meal. Even though I queued for a long time standing

author: Paramita Rut Setiawati
review_text:
Everything were so good!
The coffee, snack and food ❤️

Know I knew why this place was really famous!
Around 30 minutes in queue for the table.
But its worth enough!

author: Phummara Sirisombat
review_text: The Kopi truly hits, the egg tarts are phenomenal. Since it's super busy and popular, long queue is expected. Come at the earliest if you don't want to wait (they open at 10am) OR you can have takeaways and sit at the food court instead.

author: Zairien Sofea
review_text:
Highly recommended breakfast kopitiam spot!

Went there at 10am on weekdays for breakfast. So there was no long line of queue if u go early. A truly 10/10 experience & definitely will repeat it again.

Good taste of food, big portion, worth the price.
This branch in Pavi Bukit Jalil have friendly staffs.
The cashier chinese guy was being so friendly & nice. Keep it up 👍🏻😋

author: helios realm
review_text:
Very very crowded even more crowded than the mall's food courts.

People queue up patiently for their turns..either for cafe seating places or for purchase of famous pineapple cake 🍍,instant coffee.

So after waiting we were allocated to our seat. Service is fast and prompt.

Oriental signature nasi lemak is quite a disappointment ,only a little hint of coconut milk,,the chicken meat part is gargantuan large,,,broiler chicken?but sambal is 👍.

Oriental curry laksa (meehoon) is heavenly good,, 👍😊 love it,,,all the herbs,spice,curry swimming around your tongue.

Egg tarts is only average,,before we ate it,the crust already falling aparts.🫢😑.

Teh tarik is good,,must try it.and they are not stingy with their drinks. (Just look at the picture how it overflows.👍

author: Lanny
review_text: The one I really liked was the Ube egg tart. It was so delicious. Nasi Lemak was just ok since the rice was not too flavourful luckily the chicken was  flavourful. Surprisingly, the Curry Pan was so good.  The coffee mocha was ok. The price is a bit pricey. The waiters were not friendly. So overall everything was just ok.

author: Cyclops Grey
review_text: Tried this Oriental Kopi in Pavilion Bukit Bintang, Kuala Lumpur area. As usual you need to queue and patient to wait to taste their nice foods and beverages. This time, we ordered Nasi Lemak Ayam Goreng, Pan Mee Signature, Chicken Beehoon Curry, Polo Bun, Oriental Egg Tart, Milo, and for sure Milo Dinosaurus.

author: Planet Mars Exploration 2033
review_text:
Most of the food is slightly above average, with the coffee and polo bun possibly being the highlights. The coffee must ordered from
Counter is better than the premix brought previously. The premix packets is very normal standard and actual drink in store is better offer.

author: David Pina
review_text:
So far. It would be my fav malaysian cuisine. Their Nasi Lemak fried chicken are the best.   Huge portion, and tasty chicken. No regret for Their coffee and milktea.
But, I need to queue up for about 40 mins tp be seated. You can buy their coffee or milktea to take home away. The also have instant noodles to sell. The Pan mee was my fav too.

author: Muaz Azhari
review_text:
Food: 5/5
Atmosphere: 4/5
Service: 5/5

The queue is long, as usual. It doesnt matter when did you come. I think it might be justified, i guess?

The hamburger is good. They cook them right in front of you and then serve it on the mini pan at your place. That pan isn't really that hot so you don't need to worry much on whether your hamburger will be overcooked.

If this is your first time here, I'd suggest not to order anything original. Because you'll be served with original hamburger and then you can pour the sauce onto the to meat to your liking.

I had truffle sauce + japaneese wagyu and it was good. Probably not A5 level but it's still good nonetheless.

Will I come here again? Probably not in near future because it's quite expensive tbh haha. But is it good? Yeah definitely

author: salwana salim
review_text:
Hi everyone! It was our first time eating Donkai.
We have been serve by Mr Gam, he was very good in serving us by sharing the secret chef sauce recipe and making our rice mixing together with egg yolk, tartar sauce and others(i dont remember). But i have really good experience today! The beef was melted in mouth and so good .Oh ya I take the cheese one. Thanks Mr Gam!

author: WillEatsAsia
review_text:
Food is quite good. Had the chicken Hamburg. Served by Ei who was attentive. However my 3 friends received their patties first and I waited for very long, as they forgot mine! To be fair they did apologize.
Shop is also a bit warm- need stronger air conditioning. I was sweating while eating.
And there was a housefly flying around. Need to be taken care of!

author: Syidah Fitri
review_text: Recommend you to try this halal japanese restaurant if you come to TRX! I really live the vibe, feeling² like real japanese restaurant. They got Wagyu/Angus beef/chicken for the patty, and I would recommend you guys to choose Truffle as the sauce! It was so delicious 9/10. If you small eater like me, better choose 1 patty only, well serving portion. Btw beware with ur wallet, it's a bit pricey but worth the money! (Got tips from the worker, mix white rice with pasteurised egg + Furikake + soy sause + truffle sauce = mix² together. Best rice mix eat with the patty! 9/10) 💯✨️

author: ATasteOfWatermelon
review_text:
The food was delicious and well-prepared, with great flavors and good portions. Everything tasted fresh and satisfying. The service was also commendable.

Our server ~ Ei ~ was attentive, friendly, and made sure we had everything we needed throughout the meal. Overall, a pleasant dining experience and worth coming back for.

author: Kitty Fong
review_text:
Stumbled this place as we pass by while looking for lunch. Shocked by the crazy long queue I checked the rating of this place crazily high so we decided to go along. Total wait time : 1 hr with 70% of it waiting on the chair they provided so it’s not that miserable. We were seated by the counter so we can watch the making while waiting. The vegetables, Japanese rice and miso soup are free flow. No sharing allowed. The server pre-grilled the patties first then bring over to my mini grill plate. Here’s what we’ve tried:

1. Chicken Hamburg Original ⭐️⭐️⭐️
- The patties texture a bit firm, peppery and slight garlicky taste.

2. Chicken Hamburg Truffle Sauce ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
- It’s the same as original the hamburg while cooking on the grill however they put a sauce separately on your table so it’s for dipping it not for grilling it together. The truffle sauce tasted good.

3. Chicken Hamburg Black sauce ⭐️⭐️⭐️
- Not as interesting a truffle one, it’s a bit sweet and peppery.

4. Chicken Karaage ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
- Crispy and juicy inside, well marinated too.

Overall I feel they’re rather overhyped but again maybe it’s not their signature meat which is beef and we done eat beef. With the queue? No.

author: Lim Yong Siang
review_text:
Each bite delivers a burst of that signature Wagyu richness—a creamy, decadent flavor that coats the palate. It is savory, slightly sweet, and immensely satisfying without ever feeling greasy or heavy.
The accompanying sides—fresh, bright green broccoli florets and chunks of caramelized sweet potato or squash—are the ideal counterpoint.
A special thanks must also go to our waiter, Ziyu, whose superb service and attentive care made the dining experience truly exceptional from start to finish. This is a must-try for any true beef enthusiast.

author: Jason Tiu
review_text:
First time trying Donkai and it was a great experience. The waitress Anna was very attentive and took the time to explain the menu in detail, which made ordering easy. The food was delicious – the Japanese Wagyu hamburg was juicy and flavorful, especially cooked medium rare. The highlight for me was definitely the A5 Wagyu skewers – absolutely tender and packed with flavor, a must-try!

Service was warm and efficient, and the open kitchen counter added a lively atmosphere to the meal. Overall, a satisfying lunch and I’ll definitely come back again to try other items on the menu.

author: Chloe Lim
review_text: Zi Yu the server is providing very good service and attention to details. Fast response in refilling the side dishes and friendly. Really like her enthusiasm and will definitely come back for the kimchi. Kimchi is really good!

author: Jac Yim
review_text:
First time trying this place. Had to wait a while to get a place. Chairs were not comfortable at all. Crowded, place smells of the sizzling meat, noisy.
Lucky the food is good. Meat was quite half raw when served, despite we requested medium well. We had to cook it ourselves with the little hot plate in front of us. Free flow of vegetables, rice and soup. Dark and truffle sauces were nice.
Service was a little slow. Also the waitress seems very forgetful. Requested for more vegetables, she said ok. But proceed to do other chores. Clearing tables, arranging plates, etc. she needs to be reminded at least twice each time we want to ask for refills.
Worth a try here if you have not tried beef hamburgs.

author: Nazran
review_text:
Hi, I would like to compliment your staff member, GAM, for the excellent service he provided during my visit. He was incredibly attentive and seemed to understand exactly what I needed even before I asked. When I was just about to request something, he already anticipated it and acted immediately that level of awareness and customer care is truly impressive.

His professionalism, friendliness, and ability to read the situation made the entire dining experience smooth and enjoyable. It’s rare to meet someone who serves with such dedication and attention to detail. Please extend my appreciation to GAM he really made a positive impact on my visit, and he represents your restaurant exceptionally well.

author: JCelyn Y
review_text:
Very satisfied with the service provided by Zi Yu. Attentive, she will ask our preference in soup, veggies and even rice. Cheerful too. Definitely added points to the whole ambience.

Taste wise, I think you could start with original first. Truffle sauce will overwhelm you fast, if you are like me, not into heavy cream.

4 for atmosphere as it's rather hot from where I sat

author: maria wong
review_text:
Nothing to shout about.
The Wagyu or Angus beef patty tastes same to me, in fact Angus is more rough.
Smell is the same.
I order original and the truffle sauce is like mayo / tartar add truffle oil.
The patty is frozen & cooked on high heat then served on the small burner in front and you continue to cook until the center is warm !
if want raw its cold.
The side sauce is thousand island, soya, spicy kichimi pepper, garlic bits.
The original beef tastes plain.
To add up the taste please add soya, kichimi pepper to the grill tray to add flavour
The Extra skewers are not 1 piece of meat but thin slice of beef stacked up together

author: nial nasa
review_text: everything about this place is top notch. the food is bussing. they SERVED. the place is quiet comfy and cozy. DEFINITELY GOING TO COME AGAIN. thanks to one of the server, ROSE for guiding us. thanks donkai.

author: JasJ
review_text: First time here, I would say this is like more of a experience, beef was good vege there is brocoli and carrot unli refill. Price a lil high I can undersrand that coz they use high quality mean, good rice. The good thing is you can adjust the meat raw to welldone to urself. The most important thing the service ziyu provided was professional and attentive,  carving and make sure that we enjoy it. Soup she also ask if we need tofu or mushroom. Overall good service good food!

author: hm rfmn
review_text:
Loveee Anna’s service.
Very friendly and welcoming.
And other staff were very helpful too.

A bit steep but overall, a great experience and food.

author: Norhazwani Azami
review_text:
Had lunch here and honestly, everything was so good. The service was excellent — special shout-out to Anna for being super friendly, attentive, and making the whole experience smooth from start to finish. Staff like her really make you want to come back.

Food portions were satisfying, flavours were consistent and fresh, and they definitely don’t skimp on ingredients. ♾️/10 for Angus Beef hamburg!

Overall, a solid 5-star experience. Thank you Anna & team! Highly recommended! 🍜🔥

author: Suriani
review_text:
Saw this online and I thought it's a must to try this. So glad that we did coz it's so yummeh! Enjoy every bite of it and thank you so much Zi Yu for your awesome service. Highly recommended!👍

P/S: Please come early coz the queue can be long. Managed to snap this when we left. But worth waiting for sure.

author: Isaac Kong Ley Hon
review_text: The service is good and wagyu beef Hamburg is awesome. However you should stop forcing your staff to ask for review on purpose before your customer finished the meal! This was so killing the enjoyment about food! Please consider to stop all these nonsense by asking for feedback and making it voluntary with QR code and not forcing your customer!!! Your management is such a shame!!!

author: Jin Giap Koh
review_text: Just choose your favourite patty. They serve angus beef and wagyu beef patty. If you do not like beef there chicken in the menu also. They will pan fry the patty in front of you. So you control the doneness of your beef your own. All choice come with unlimited rice, miso soup, vege. The food is super nice, highly recommend for people like to eat burger but with rice instead of bun. Oh yea, there is kimchi at the desk together with the sauces.

author: Madam Wee
review_text: Had a lovely and romantic evening celebrating my birthday here, arranged by my husband. 💕 The ambience was beautiful, the food was above average, and the staff were super friendly — especially Nick, who helped us take many great photos. They even surprised us with a complimentary brownie cake and offered a 20% discount for birthdays! Parking can also be validated — just show your dining receipt. Perfect place for special occasions. We’ll definitely come again! ✨

author: Sha Natasya
review_text: Excellent service from staff member Nick!⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ He was very friendly and even helped us take a lovely family photo. I celebrated my father’s birthday here, and Nick made the occasion even more special. This staff member is truly outstanding as he represents the company with a very positive image. The company should really appreciate and value staff like him. Thank you for the warm, attentive, and professional service truly a great experience. Highly recommended!

author: SHARMILA NAIR
review_text: Had a great time celebrating birthday here. The food portion and the price was reasonable. Nick was very kind and helpful throughout the planning. He also help us took alot of pictures in various spots. It was a memorable dining for us.

author: sn.niagamotors
review_text:
We came to Sarastro to celebrate my wife’s birthday and had a great experience. The food was delicious and beautifully prepared, and the atmosphere was perfect for a special occasion.

What truly stood out was the service from Nick and Lisa. They were professional, warm, and very attentive, and they made us feel genuinely welcome from the moment we arrived. Their care and attention really made the evening memorable. They are a real credit to Sarastro and absolutely deserve recognition from management. Highly recommended. 🤍

author: M Zulfadly
review_text: Come here for anniversary celebration. Cosy place for dinner. Food is so delicious, affordable and generous portion size for the price. Although only 3-4 table, waiting time for food is quite long around 20-30 min. Interior is so pretty and classic. Live singer performance but not too loud. Staff neek rajiv and lisa very helpful and friendly.

author: 권희윤
review_text: Lila and Coline were always there for me, helping with everything and bringing so much laughter to my family. They truly touched my heart. Lila, especially, impressed me with her kindness and the sincerity she puts into everything she does. Her smile stayed in my mind—it made every moment brighter. I truly hope that they are always happy, because they deserves that and more. The food and music were wonderful too, but what made this place special was them. I wish I could stay at this hotel even longer, just to keep this warm feeling a little more.

author: HAZWANI AZMAN
review_text: Had a great breakfast experience here! The food was fresh and tasty with a good variety of choices. The staff Nick were friendly and provided excellent service throughout. I also loved the beautiful view.. it made the morning feel so calm and refreshing. Definitely a perfect way to start the day

author: Amit Singh
review_text: Had a really great time here. Came to celebrate birthday and we enjoyed every bit of it. The staff here are very helpful and friendly as well. Especially staff name Seth , Tina & Lisa served us very good. Will definitely come again next time !

author: Clover Ying
review_text: I would like to thank you Nick for served us during my birthday dinner. He are so helpful and help me took a lot of nice photo. He did very well and more than enough. If you have any celebrate please look for Nick, for sure he will give you the best support!

author: Pratha Shan
review_text: 6 of us came for dinner and we had a good time. Staffs are well trained. Food was good. I loved the salted egg pasta, calamari, fruit de lune and rack of lamb. Nice ambience too. Nick and Tina took good care of us.

author: Priya Chandran
review_text:
i went to this place because the reviews were extremely good, but honestly, it was a huge disappointment.
Booked a table for a birthday celebration and chose a package that was supposed to include free table decoration. Please don’t be misled, the decoration was about 7 fake flower petals on the table. Lol . Worse, they forgot to even put it out when we arrived. Fyi: if you want balloons its rm100 extra.
The food was another letdown. We paid around RM300 and were served mushroom soup and chicken that weren’t even warm. At the very least, it could have been reheated. Paying that amount for cold food is unacceptable.
The staff were clearly more focused on entertaining their corporate event tables,
But we are also paying. Thats not fair. If you want to focus then please dont book usual tables.
I came with very high expectations, especially since it was a birthday dinner. Unfortunately, the experience completely spoiled the night. I won’t be returning.

author: Lee KH
review_text:
Heard the lamb was good so I decided to give it a try during lunch. The place was empty but was warmly greeted by Rajiv who served me throughout lunch.

Ordered the lamb. There was a hiccup in terms of how the meat was cooked. While the dish pleasantly displayed, it was cooked 2 notch higher then intended.

However, the service recovery by Rajiv was excellent even though I showed no displeasure - the food was indeed delicious even though it was medium well instead of medium rare. He raised the bar for customer experience.

Had the tiramisu for dessert which was a little heavy for me. Decent taste, not too sweet.

It was a great lunch overall. There is live band during the night, will visit again for dinner one day.

author: Sharminii Edween
review_text: My husband booked this place for my birthday and we had a wonderful dinner.. The service team Neek ,Tina and Rajib did an amazing job serving us time to time. The food here is absolutely delicious and presentation is beautiful too. We will surely come here again for another occasion.

author: Muhammad Syahazmil Mohd Zaki (Syamil)
review_text: I had an amazing experience at Sarastro KL by Millennium, all thanks to the outstanding service by Coline and Tina. Both were exceptionally warm, attentive, and professional throughout my visit. Coline made sure every detail was perfect, while Tina’s friendly attitude made me feel truly welcomed. Their hospitality added a personal touch that made the whole experience memorable. Highly recommend this place — especially if you’re lucky enough to be served by Coline and Tina!

author: Joachim Martin Devassy
review_text:
Stayed here for 3 days 2 night..
It was a wonderful stay here.
The restaurant her is so good..
The choice of food is not variety. However
the service and atmosphere is super duper good.. Nik and Zilah was so helpful by guiding us the way to the restaurant
and always being there when ever we need them

author: kerry robb
review_text:
Just visited this place and how it gets the amazing reviews is beyond me. Drinks were old fashioned and pina colada. I honestly think they forgot the alcohol in both!! Starters arrived within 10 minutes then mains were fetched before starters were half eaten. We sent the mains back as we knew they would be cold. When we did get them they were indeed cold. Sprouts were rock hard, mash potato cold, sweetcorn chargrilled but stone cold. The steak was nice but for the price so disappointing.
Honestly this place is just a gimmick and we have eaten better in the mall for far cheaper.

author: iklil izdihar abdul ghani
review_text: The food was really nice. The steak superb just melting in my mouth. Nick also very nice staff and help to take our picture. Recommended!

author: hodhan hassan
review_text:
In addition to the wonderful dinner and the warm service from Tina and Lisa, we were even serenaded, making it an unforgettable experience overall.
Zila and Coline the breakfast team amazing service and makes you feel at home

author: Laurel Chen
